title: Big Fish
tagline: Some fish stories are true. This dinner is.
about: A son tries to separate fact from fiction in his dying father's tall tales.
cue: Serve the mains when Edward tells the story of the giant catfish.

and sea salt.Pop 100g popping corn in 2 tbsp oil in a covered pot and tip into a large bowl with 100g roasted peanuts.Boil 100g butter, 200g brown sugar and 60ml golden syrup for 4 minutes, then stir
